title: Mystic Emerald Hooded Gown
content:
This couture gown features a sculptural silhouette, a dramatic hood, and iridescent emerald textures. Designed in Clo3D by TWINZ, this piece blends fantasy fashion with futuristic elegance.

![4e64c7961a714717b7aacf59d88a3149](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/4505ce8386bb48dba33492bfad08aa83/images/4e64c7961a714717b7aacf59d88a3149TWINZ_DRESS_WORK%206.2.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: That iridescent fabric is absolutely hypnotic 😍
Reply 1: Thank you! I'm really happy that you liked it😍.
content_description: Showcasing the TWINZ couture gown designed in Clo3D, this page highlights a futuristic, fantasy-inspired fashion piece with a sculptural silhouette and iridescent emerald textures.
